Abathor - Ultimate Edition!

The definitive way to experience this brutal 2D action-platformer — solo or with up to 4 players.
Embark on an epic 16-bit quest inspired by Retro Games, and fight to reclaim Atlantis from the forces of darkness.

Enjoy authentic pixel art crafted by veteran artists from the era, and a killer chiptune soundtrack
featuring legends like Soyo Oka , Gryzor87 , and many more.

This Ultimate Edition features major upgrades:
- Speed meets brutality: Characters now run! All hitboxes redesigned for a faster, fresher, and more dynamic experience.
- A handcrafted world map like no other: Fully redrawn in pixel art — massive, detailed, and unprecedented in retro-style worldbuilding.
- Balanced difficulty modes: From Adventure Mode for newcomers to Heroic Mode with more accessible saves for seasoned players.
- SpeedRun Mode: All characters rebalanced to give everyone a fair shot at being the fastest.
- Tuned progression:

Salieri’s not here to play games.

Get your first look at the new gameplay features and items coming to Mafia: The Old Country when the Man of Honor expansion releases on August 14, 2026.

► Learn more and wishlist now: https://2kgam.es/ManOfHonor

Sicily – Winter, 1905. In the months since his initiation, Enzo Favara has proven himself a reliable soldier of the Torrisi crime family. Now the Don entrusts him and Cesare with a delicate assignment: assist Ennio Salieri, a man of honor recently released from prison and intent on reclaiming what is his.

At Salieri's side, Enzo is drawn deeper into the volatile underworld of the Valle Dorata, where loyalty is tested, debts are settled, and every move carries weight.

Continue Enzo's story across two new chapters, featuring fresh environments, weapons, vehicles, and Charms. In new DLC content for Free Ride mode, team up with Salieri to earn big by taking on a new set of exclusive jobs and extreme challenges, and discover new collectibles a
title: Mafia: The Old Country - Man of Honor Gameplay First Look | PS5 Games

author: PlayStation
description:
https://www.playstation.com/games/big-walk/

Big Walk is out today! Hang out and get lost with close friends in a big world. A cooperative online walker-talker from the creators of Untitled Goose Game.

Set out with your friends through a wide-open world full of challenges, puzzles, and discoveries. You’ll need to work together to find your way around, stay in contact using an assortment of tools and toys, and figure out new ways to communicate when you suddenly find yourself speechless.

Adventuring aside, there’s plenty of time to just hang out. Sit and watch the sunset, or steal your friend’s binoculars and kick them into the ocean. Spending time with friends is the best part of a big walk.

#ps5 #ps5games
title: Big Walk - Launch Trailer | PS5 Games
